Lemma
[First-order expansion of the next coefficient] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0276 ↗ lem:chow-iii-ch23-recursive-formula ↗ lem:chow-iii-ch23-leading-coefficient-derivatives 1. ch23:23.33\group Asymptotics

\[ \phi _1(x,y)=\frac16R(y)+\frac1{12}(\nabla _rR)(y)x^r+O(r^2). \]
Proof

\sketch Insert the expansion of $\Delta \phi _0$ into the integral formula for $\phi _1$; the substitution $x\mapsto \exp _y(\rho rV)$ replaces $x^r$ by $\rho x^r$ and integrating $\rho $ from zero to one gives the coefficient $1/12$.

□
